say.en: Want to run your first program on an ESP32? Here's the whole setup, in under a minute.

show.en: Want to run your first program on an ESP32? Here's the whole setup, in under a minute.

say.en: Step one: download the free Arduino IDE, from arduino dot cc.

show.en: Step one: download the free Arduino IDE, from arduino.cc.

say.en: Step two: paste Espressif's board URL into Preferences, then install esp32 from the Boards Manager.

show.en: Step two: paste Espressif's board URL into Preferences, then install esp32 from the Boards Manager.

say.en: Step three: plug in your board. If Windows can't see it, install the C P 2102, or C H 340 driver.

show.en: Step three: plug in your board. If Windows can't see it, install the CP2102 or CH340 driver.

say.en: Then select ESP32 Dev Module, and your COM port.

show.en: Then select ESP32 Dev Module, and your COM port.

say.en: Step five: write a few lines of C, and hit Upload.

show.en: Step five: write a few lines of C, and hit Upload.

say.en: And just like that, your ESP32 is talking to you!
